description:
The map displays an urban landscape, likely from false-colour infrared satellite imagery, illustrating land cover classification. The image does not specify a geographic location, but the colours distinguish vegetated areas from built-up areas. Yellow lines delineate distinct land cover polygons, each identified by a numeric code.

Areas classified as `1110` appear in light green/grey tones, representing built-up surfaces such as buildings and roads, consistent with CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class `1.1.1 Continuous urban fabric`. Three such `1110` polygons are visible, forming the matrix of the urban environment.

Two larger polygons are classified as `1400`, shown in dark red, indicating dense vegetation. These areas correspond to CLC categories like `1.4.1 Green urban areas` or `1.4.2 Sport and leisure facilities` (sub-classes of Artificial, non-agricultural vegetated areas) as suggested by the surrounding document context referencing "Green urban areas" and "Golf course" examples.

The map visually demonstrates the spatial distribution of green urban spaces (1400) within the surrounding urban fabric (1110). No scale bar, compass, legend, or reference year is visible.
